name: Twin Knuckle
description: Strike with both hands in one beat, a charged knuckle in each, so the target feels two bites.

name: Dual Ward
description: Hold two shells of charge, one before the chest and one behind the back, against blows from both sides.

name: Pairing Read
description: Send a pair of sparks apart and read the field from the difference in what each returns.

name: Joined Step
description: Take two linked steps on one pulse, left foot and right, so the body crosses the gap whole.

name: Twin Thunder
description: Clap down two peals from opposite hands that meet in the middle of the foes between them.

name: Dual Lash
description: Lash from both sides at once and leave the arcs wrapped about the target's arms to hold them.

name: Matched Fork
description: Drive a forked bolt from each hand into the same gap in a guard.

name: Pair Sunder
description: Cross two bolts inside a target's armour so the shock runs back and forth and tears the plate apart.

name: Doubled Peal
description: Loose a peal and its twin in one beat, the second falling on those who were struck by the first.

name: Cleaving Pair
description: Bring two great bolts down from opposite sides so that they cross over the target in a cleaving star of light.

name: Azure Spark
description: Cast a bright blue-white spark that cuts the air like a falling hawk.

name: Arc Wings
description: Spread the arms like wings and hold a broad shell of charge over the chest and sides.

name: Soar Read
description: Lift the senses on a thread of charge above the head and read the field from a height.

name: Pinion Surge
description: Beat the arms once and surge several paces forward on a pulse from the shoulders.

name: Spark Beak
description: Thrust a stiffened two-finger jab at a weak point with a bolt behind it.

name: Diving Bolt
description: Loose a bolt that dives at its mark from above and strikes the crown and shoulders.

name: Stoop Lash
description: Fall on a guard with a hard lash of charge from high above the target's head.

name: Wing Turn
description: Bank into the blow like a hawk in a gust, and let the shock slide off the outstretched arm.

name: Plummet Lance
description: Fall from a height on a lance of charge that pierces the guard and shocks the body under it.

name: Rending Talon
description: Hook the fingers into a talon of charge and tear through a shield, leaving the arm beneath it limp.

name: Descending Lightning
description: Drop out of a clear field as a single bolt of lightning and strike the target before a blink is made.

name: Deep Gather
description: Draw static in through the whole body over many slow breaths, filling the user to the bone.

name: Gathered Skin
description: Let the gathered charge crowd under the skin so that it hardens against blows.

name: Charge Weigh
description: Weigh how much charge is in the body and how much more it can safely bear.

name: Massed Charge
description: Mass the gathered charge in the arms and chest so that every strike carries a heavy surplus.

name: Gathered Bolt
description: Loose a bolt that carries a good part of the gathered charge into a single target.

name: Release Peal
description: Let the pressure of a gathered body break out all at once in a peal around the user.

name: Brimming Fist
description: Punch with the fist brimming over with charge, so that it spills into the target as lightning.

name: Overflow Arc
description: Let the surplus overflow in arcs from the whole body into every foe near enough to be struck.

name: Overfull Discharge
description: Empty the entire body's gathered charge in one blinding burst that devastates all ground within a wide reach.

name: Reach Spark
description: Throw a spark that holds its brightness far beyond the usual short flight.

name: Long Ward
description: Stretch the guard forward on a thread of charge to catch missiles before they reach the user.

name: Distance Read
description: Run a line of charge out to a far mark and judge the range by how long it takes to return.

name: Extending Step
description: Stretch each stride along a line of charge and cover a long run in a few steps.

name: Lengthened Jab
description: Thrust the fist out and let a lance of charge extend a pace beyond the knuckles.

name: Reaching Bolt
description: Loose a bolt that crosses a wide gap without losing force and strikes at full weight.

name: Long Lash
description: Crack a long lash of charge across a far target and drag it off its feet.

name: Far Parry
description: Knock a long-range bolt aside with a thread of charge cast out to meet it.

name: Trailing Snare
description: Leave a snare of charge trailing from the bolt to wrap the target on arrival.

name: Distant Spear
description: Cast a spear of lightning to a far target and drive through shield and plate together.

name: Farthest Arc
description: Cast a great arc to the end of sight, striking any foe in the broad lane beneath it.

name: Lightning Lance
description: Hurl a lance of pure lightning through the far foe and everything standing in a line behind them.

name: Rift Spark
description: Cast a spark into a seam in a guard and open a crack that the next blow widens.

name: Parting Ward
description: Part the force of a blow on a wedge of charge so that it passes to either side.

name: Seam Tingle
description: Read by the pull of charge where the joins and weak seams of armour lie.

name: Splitting Step
description: Step along the seam of a rival's stance and arrive on their open side.

name: Sundering Lash
description: Lash at a seam in the guard so that the charge enters and tears it wider.

name: Seam Bolt
description: Thread a bolt through the gap between two plates into the body beneath.

name: Break Arc
description: Send an arc through a foe's stance that snaps the line of their balance in two.

name: Plate Cleaver
description: Bring a blade-shaped arc down on armoured shoulders and cleave through plate to the flesh.

name: Rift Arc
description: Draw an arc across the ground that splits the footing of every foe it crosses.

name: Great Sunder
description: Split the whole stance of a group in one grand arc that tears guards, shields and footing apart.

name: Low Voice
description: Let the low voice of thunder roll and shake the sense of balance in the ears of those near.

name: High Voice
description: Crack the high voice once, sharply, to break the focus of a foe in the middle of a cast.

name: Chorus Ward
description: Sound a steady shell of charge in both voices so blows land on a humming wall of sound.

name: Voice Read
description: Listen to the echo of both voices off bodies and read their number and distance.

name: Answering Spark
description: Reply to an enemy's cast with a spark that follows the hostile charge back to its source.

name: Call Bolt
description: Cast the first voice as a bolt that rings out and draws the foe's eye.

name: Reply Bolt
description: Cast the second voice as a bolt that lands from behind just after the first.

name: Voiced Lash
description: Lash a target with a crack and a rumble together, so the strike rings in the bones.

name: Harmonic Parry
description: Sound a note that matches a blow's own shock and cancels part of it.

name: Two-Note Peal
description: Sound a low note and a high note together in a great peal that rocks all within reach.

name: Counterpoint Strike
description: Strike on the off-beat of the foe's own rhythm, a pulse landing just where their guard has lowered.

name: Resounding Arc
description: Send an arc that rings through a guard, shaking its plates and the bones beneath.

name: Thunder Duet
description: Join both voices at their peak in one crash that deafens and breaks the casting of all within reach.

name: Held Spark
description: Keep a spark ready at the fingertip a while before loosing it at a mark.

name: Held Ward
description: Hold the shell of charge over the body without letting it waver under pressure.

name: Oath Read
description: Read the charge of a sworn mark and feel when its position shifts.

name: Held Stride
description: Keep a steady stride with charge held in the legs until the moment to leap.

name: Held Peal
description: Hold a peal under the ribs for a long moment and break it open over those close by.

name: Pledge Bolt
description: Loose a bolt on a pledged line that cannot be turned from its mark.

name: Held Parry
description: Catch a blow on stilled charge and hold it until it is turned aside.

name: Withheld Fist
description: Withhold the punch till the last breath, then drive the stored shock home in one blow.

name: Hold Fork
description: Pin a target in place with a forked bolt held in them while the user moves in.

name: Oath Thunder
description: Loose thunder held for a long time all at once on a sworn mark and the ground around it.

name: Pledged Spark
description: Pledge a spark to a target by name and aim, then loose it so it does not stray.

name: Pledged Shell
description: Pledge the guard to one ally and keep a shell of charge on them that holds as long as the pledge.

name: Pledge Read
description: Feel the pledged mark's charge and follow it as it moves through the field.

name: Pledged Bolt
description: Loose a bolt on a pledged line that curves with the target if it runs.

name: Sworn Lash
description: Lash at the pledged target so the charge holds on them after the blow.

name: Oathstep
description: Step along the pledge to the pledged mark and appear within reach of it.

name: Pledged Lance
description: Throw a lance on a sworn line to pierce all guards between the user and the mark.

name: Pledge Crash
description: Bring down thunder on the pledged mark and those who stand close beside it.

name: Binding Lightning
description: Strike with lightning that stays and wraps the target in living bonds of charge until the user lets go.

name: Bearing Spark
description: Cast a spark along the bearing held in the mind, indifferent to the roar around it.

name: Unshaken Ward
description: Keep a shell of charge that does not flicker, even as the sky rolls and the ground shakes.

name: Course Read
description: Read the heading of the thunder and judge where the next strike falls.

name: Set Stride
description: Plant a stride on the bearing and push off it with a pulse from the heel.

name: Plumb Jab
description: Drive a straight charged jab down the true line of the arm into the target.

name: Plumb Bolt
description: Loose a bolt perfectly straight so that no gust can push it aside.

name: Course Parry
description: Turn a blow onto the bearing and send its force away along that same line.

name: Aim Break
description: Send a pulse that knocks a foe's aim awry just as the cast is loosed.

name: Straight Lance
description: Throw a lance along one unbroken line to pierce whatever stands on the bearing.

name: Unswerving Fork
description: Cast a forked bolt whose prongs follow two bearings and cannot be turned by a single guard.

name: Unerring Bolt
description: Loose a bolt that finds the target's weak point whatever guard stands between, shocking the body within.

name: Broad Spark
description: Cast a broad fan of sparks that cover more ground than a single bolt.

name: Wide Ward
description: Open the shell wide to cover companions standing beside the user.

name: Spread Read
description: Spread the field in every direction and read the position of all in it at once.

name: Roving Step
description: Step in whichever direction the charge pulls, trusting the field to guide the feet.

name: Broad Palm
description: Slap the open palm wide and flat across a target with a sweep of charge.

name: Broad Bolt
description: Loose a thick bolt as wide as a body that a dodge to one side cannot escape.

name: Open Lash
description: Swing a wide lash that sweeps across the whole front of a group.

name: Roving Parry
description: Roll the guard around the body to meet each blow from whatever side it falls.

name: Spread Arc
description: Fan an arc out from the hands in a wide half circle before the user.

name: Sweeping Bolt
description: Sweep a held bolt in a long arc across the field and shock every foe it passes.

name: Open Crash
description: Slam the whole body, open and unguarded, into a target on a blast of charge.

name: Vast Bolt
description: Cast a bolt as wide as a hall that falls over all the ground before the user and nothing there escapes it.

name: Keeping Spark
description: Cast a spark that remains alight on a target for a few beats after it hits.

name: Kept Ward
description: Keep a shell of charge in place through a long exchange without wavering.

name: Keeper Read
description: Watch the field with a steady charge and mark each change in the bodies near.

name: Standing Step
description: Take a single firm step to the side without breaking the stance or the guard.

name: Kept Peal
description: Loose a peal that waits until a foe presses close, then breaks over them.

name: Standing Parry
description: Stand and turn a blow on the guard without giving a step.

name: Steadfast Lash
description: Lash back along the line of the blow that was just turned, striking the one who sent it.

name: Unbroken Fist
description: Punch with a fist wrapped in an unbroken ring of charge that does not fade on contact.

name: Vow Crash
description: Slam down a crash of thunder round the user's feet to hold every foe at the edge of it.

name: Stored Strike
description: Take a bolt of lightning into the body unharmed, keep its force, and return it through the next blow.

name: Final Spark
description: Cast a last spark at the end of a combination, bright enough to blind.

name: Closing Hum
description: Close the guard fast over the user after a strike to blunt the answering blow.

name: Final Read
description: Judge in one pulse how much strength a foe has left and where it is lowest.

name: Closing Step
description: Step in to close the last gap at the end of a run of blows.

name: Closing Jab
description: Jab the weakened point of a foe with a charged knuckle after the guard has broken.

name: Closing Bolt
description: Loose a bolt at a foe whose guard has just been opened, to finish the exchange.

name: Last Lash
description: Lash through the very end of a stagger and fell the foe cleanly.

name: Final Parry
description: Turn the foe's last desperate blow aside and open the way for a reply.

name: Final Crash
description: Bring a heavy crash down on a group at the end of a fight and scatter what remains.

name: Final Lance
description: Drive a single lance through a foe whose guard has failed, ending the fight in one point.

name: Closing Verdict
description: Deliver a final stroke that no guard can turn, and its shock passes straight through to the nerves beneath.
